stem_book: A hollow vertical cylinder of radius r and height h has a smooth internal surface. A small particle is placed in contact with the inner side of the upper rim, at point A, and given a horizontal speed u, tangential to the rim. It leaves the lower rim at point B, vertically below A. If the total number of revolutions made by the particle inside the cylinder n is an integer, then: (a) (u/2πr)√(2h/g) = n (b) h/(2πr) = n (c) 2πr/h = n (d) u/√(2gh) = n
work: fall time t = √(2h/g) (normal force is horizontal) ; arc u·t = n·2πr → n = (u/2πr)√(2h/g)
